description: Returns EU public-contract winners from official TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) award notices published since a date: who won, which buyer, value, CPV and lots. Use it to find new awards or what a company has won; use awards_get_contract for one known notice, and tenders_list_deadline_changes for open tender deadlines, not winners. Inputs (all optional, they narrow together): since (YYYY-MM-DD, default 7 days ago; about 45 days are kept), cpv (up to 5 comma-separated CPV prefixes of 2 to 8 digits, e.g. 72 for IT services), country (buyer, 3-letter ISO code as TED uses, e.g. DEU), winner (name prefix, at least 3 letters, e.g. Mennica Polska), winner_id (exact official id, e.g. PL1234567890), limit (1 to 50, default 20) and cursor (next_cursor, same filters). Output: awards[] with winners, buyer, value, CPV, dates, lots, notice URL and SHA-256 proof, plus count, has_more, next_cursor and feed (checked_at, coverage). Stored observations, not a live TED search; check feed.checked_at. Terms: read-only; MCP calls are never charged. Without a key, metered routes give 10 successful answers a day free (unmetered routes are unlimited); errors do not count. On the paid HTTP routes, errors and empty answers are free. An optional API key keeps its prepaid-credit policy. When the free answers run out, the error names the HTTP alternative.

country.description: Buyer country, 3-letter ISO code as TED uses, e.g. DEU, FRA, POL

cpv.description: CPV code or prefix, 2 to 8 digits, e.g. 72 for IT services; up to 5, comma-separated

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from this tool's prior answer; a followed by 1 to 12 digits, e.g. a0. Keep filters unchanged; omit on first call.

since.description: Awards published on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 7 days ago; about 45 days are kept); e.g. 2026-10-01. Must be a parseable YYYY-MM-DD date.

winner.description: Winner name prefix, e.g. Mennica Polska; at least 3 normalized letters/digits; case/accent/punctuation-insensitive, normalized text truncated to 200 characters

winner_id.description: Winner official identifier, e.g. PL1234567890; exact normalized match, at least 3 letters/digits; punctuation ignored and normalized key truncated to 64 characters

name: awards_list_contracts
title: List EU contract awards
